title: Symbols read in a configuration
statement: For a finite-tape Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input symbols and a configuration $c$ on input $x$, let the read data be the pair consisting of the symbol at input-tape position $0$ and, for each work tape, the symbol at position $0$. Each symbol is optional, with absence representing a blank cell.
